title: Esko Nikkari
plot:
Esko Nikkari, born on November 23, 1938, in Lapua, Finland, was an esteemed Finnish actor whose career spanned several decades, resulting in over 70 film and television roles. He made his acting debut in 1974 with the film *Karvat*. 

Nikkari became a prominent figure in the works of the Kaurismäki
